understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid and complete every level by activating each goal cell. A goal activates only when the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation all match the goal’s requirements, then the player must step onto it.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, and reaching zero stamina costs a life before resetting stamina. Walls block movement, so blocked_directions must be checked before every move. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle orange→blue→green→red→orange, and rotation modifiers rotate clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. Stamina refills restore stamina, activated goals complete, and completing all goals advances the level; losing all lives ends the game.
